findings.title: Hourly total is not checked for overflow
findings.why: The daily branch rejects totals that are not safe integers with 'total is too large'. The hourly branch computes `hours * hourlyPrice` with no such check. `addEquipment` accepts any safe-integer `hourlyPrice`, so a large one (for example 2^52) makes a multi-hour quote or booking return an imprecise or unsafe `total` instead of an error.
